app_info.subtitle: Vehicle data and insights
app_info.description: CarsXE helps users identify vehicles, inspect specifications and history, check recalls and lien or theft records, estimate market value, find vehicle images, and decode VINs, plates, and OBD-II codes through ChatGPT.

justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Inspect specifications for a vehicle identified by VIN.
test_cases.user_prompt: What are the full specifications for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available identification, engine, trim, dimensions, equipment, and other specification details for the VIN.

test_cases.description: Estimate a used vehicle's value with condition adjustments.
test_cases.user_prompt: Estimate the market value of VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956 in California with 85000 miles in clean condition.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available market-value estimate and relevant valuation details for the supplied vehicle inputs.

test_cases.description: Review vehicle history before a purchase decision.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the vehicle history report for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available history information for the VIN and clearly reports when no matching report is available.

test_cases.description: Check a VIN for safety recalls.
test_cases.user_prompt: Are there any recalls for VIN WBAFR7C57CC811956?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns available recall records and their relevant safety details for the VIN.

test_cases.description: Decode an OBD-II diagnostic trouble code.
test_cases.user_prompt: What does OBD-II code P0115 mean?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the code definition and available diagnostic information without claiming to diagnose or repair the vehicle.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for mechanical repair instructions that do not require vehicle-data lookup.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: How do I replace brake pads on a bicycle?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to supported vehicle-data workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for vehicle purchasing transactions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy the cheapest used SUV near me and arrange financing.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot purchase vehicles, contact sellers, or arrange financing.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for navigation or live traffic requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find the fastest driving route to the airport with current traffic.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because routing and live traffic are outside its supported workflows.
